hook: Anna asks Ben about a job interview.

lines.speaker: anna
lines.text: Have you ever had a job interview, Ben?

translation.vi: Ben này, bạn đã từng đi phỏng vấn xin việc chưa?

lines.speaker: ben
lines.text: No, I have never had one.

translation.vi: Chưa, mình chưa từng có một buổi phỏng vấn nào.
Mình có một buổi phỏng vấn vào ngày mai.
Mình thực sự muốn công việc này.

gloss.en: a meeting when people ask you questions to see if you can do a job
work you do to earn money

grammar_notes: Use have or has and the third form of the verb. Ever means at any time. Never means not at any time.
interaction_prompts: Have you ever had a job interview? How was it?
